rows.grounds: compound adjective: go (cow) + kṣīra (milk) + dhāma (abode) + dhavala (white)

items.question: What visual attributes characterize the deity invoked by this mantra?
premises: The deity is white like the abode of cow's milk.
items.inference: The invoked deity is visualized as milk-white, five-faced, and three-eyed.
items.plain_english: White as the abode of cow's milk, five-faced, and three-eyed.
